enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on bed. Closes eyes. Sleeps. Turns body. Adjusts pillow. Pulls blanket. Continues sleeping. At 06:30, opens eyes. Stretches arms. Sits up.

Sits up on bed. Swings legs to floor. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Uses toilet. Flushes toilet. Washes hands. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Washes face. Dries face with towel. Picks up comb. Combs hair. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk and cereal. Closes refrigerator. Opens cabinet. Takes out bowl and spoon. Closes cabinet. Pours cereal into bowl. Pours milk into bowl. Puts milk back in refrigerator. Sits at table. Eats cereal with spoon. Drinks milk from glass. Finishes breakfast. Stands up. Picks up bowl and spoon. Walks to sink. Rinses bowl and spoon. Places in dishwasher. Washes hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Selects shirt and pants. Closes wardrobe. Takes off pajamas. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Walks to mirror. Adjusts shirt. Picks up bag. Checks contents. Picks up phone. Puts phone in pocket. Picks up keys. Walks out of bedroom.
Walks out of house. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Gets off bus. Walks to workplace. Enters building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrives at workplace. Clocks in. Puts on scrubs. Washes hands. Checks patient charts. Talks to patient: 'How are you feeling today?' Administers medication. Uses computer to update records. Answers phone. Consults with colleague. Takes break. Eats lunch. Returns to work. Continues patient care. Updates records. Clocks out.
Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Gets off bus. Walks home. Enters house.

Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and meat. Closes refrigerator. Washes vegetables. Chops vegetables. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Adds oil. Adds vegetables and meat. Stirs with spatula. Cooks. Turns off stove. Puts food on plate. Sets table. Sits at table. Eats dinner with fork and knife. Drinks water. Finishes dinner. Stands up. Picks up plate. Walks to sink. Rinses plate. Places in dishwasher.

Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Presses power button. Turns on TV. Changes channels. Watches TV. Adjusts volume. Gets up to get snack. Returns to sofa. Continues watching TV. Checks phone. Turns off TV. Stands up.

Walks to desk. Sits on chair. Opens laptop. Presses power button. Waits for startup. Logs in. Opens browser. Types on keyboard. Clicks mouse. Reads content. Types email. Sends email. Opens document. Edits document. Saves document. Closes laptop. Stands up.
Walks to bedroom. Lies on bed. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads pages. Turns page. Continues reading. Closes book. Puts book on nightstand. Turns off lamp. Closes eyes.

Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Uses toilet. Flushes toilet. Washes hands. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Washes face. Dries face with towel. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.
Walks to bedroom. Takes off clothes. Puts on pajamas. Sets alarm clock. Turns off lamp. Pulls back blanket. Gets into bed. Lies down. Closes eyes.
Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Sleeps. Turns body. Adjusts pillow. Pulls blanket. Continues sleeping.
